name: rust-cli
description: Part of Grimoire's `rust-cli` bundle: installs the `adr-writer` and `project-docs` plugins. Left out: `conventional-commits` (a rule) is not published as a plugin; install it with the grimoire CLI. The whole bundle: Conventional Commits, architecture decision records and a read-only docs server for Rust CLI projects. Needs `grimoire-mcp-project-docs` on PATH.
